explication: Kiro Crew is a persistent development workspace that runs locally or remotely, exposing agent work through desktop, web, CLI, and messaging surfaces. The principal workflow is a user initiating a conversation or long-running task, an agent executing it through an ACP backend, and session state surviving for later continuation. The README also describes learning, skills, autonomy, delegation, and installable Apps. The graph combines those documented capabilities with the source paths visible in the tree; detailed runtime wiring was not sampled, so links beyond the excerpts are documented relationships rather than inspected calls.
